# awscc_sagemaker_cluster_scheduler_config (Data Source)

Data Source schema for AWS::SageMaker::ClusterSchedulerConfig

## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `cluster_arn` (String) ARN of the cluster.
- `cluster_scheduler_config_arn` (String) ARN of the cluster policy.
- `cluster_scheduler_config_id` (String) ID of the cluster policy.
- `cluster_scheduler_config_version` (Number) Version of the cluster policy.
- `creation_time` (String) Creation time of the cluster policy.
- `description` (String) Description of the cluster policy.
- `name` (String) Name for the cluster policy.
- `scheduler_config` (Attributes) Cluster policy configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--scheduler_config))
- `status` (String) Status of the cluster policy.
- `tags` (Attributes List) Tags of the cluster policy. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

Read-Only:

- `priority_classes` (Attributes List) List of priority class configurations. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--scheduler_config--priority_classes))
